<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Shipping" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Invitation to make offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Offers received"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shipping" name="Shipping of goods" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticCompanies" name="Logistic companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Shipping of goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_GoodsToShip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipper</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OffersReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" name="Goods shall be shipped">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Split">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountSplit" name="Amount?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OffersReceived" name="Offers received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OffersReceived" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Select one logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Ship by normal post">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountMerge" name="Shipping method determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" name="Insurance necessary?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" name="Insurance handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Everything ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AmountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Large amounts" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Small amounts" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_NormalPost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Event_OffersReceived" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountMerge" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Insurance necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Not necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
